messages:
maya: Quick sync 10am tomorrow to finalize competitive messaging for the launch: blog + benchmark appendix + webinar. Need one benchmark narrative, 3 field-ready soundbites, and a clear inbound routing map.

alex: CTAs Im testing: "Predictable inference, predictable cost" and "One API across hosted, dedicated, private". Will bring landing page copy.

sam: For benchmarks: prioritize 95th PCTL latency on a mixed prompt set (chat + long-form) vs. cloud-hosted endpoints. Show cost delta with batching+cache. Recommend a short GIF of throughput and a small appendix with harness details.

jen: Sales-ready lines: 1) "Ship LLM features without hiring ops" 2) "Control unit economics, not just model access". Two variants: concise and customer-story.

aaron: Inbound routing rule sketch: if compliance == true OR industry == regulated -> AE + solutions-eng; elseif est_monthly_cost > $2k -> SDR -> AE; else -> self-serve trial + nurture. Shareable matrix soon.

pat_k: Add a UI micro-play: during signup, checkbox "Requires enterprise security" => surface Dedicated/Private and route to AE. Also flag for legal/contract review.

nick_r: Webinar angle: "How we reduced inference unit cost by 3x while hitting p50,p95 SLOs". Demo QPS, latency percentiles, short live-run of fallback routing. Keep it 30 mins with ops+engineer Q&A.

maya: Important: benchmark claims need test spec + model family stated. Ops-bot: remind research/legal to sign off before publish.

ops-bot: Reminder - attach test-harness README, list of models (family + weights), and raw prompt set. Ops-bot also suggests anonymized customer workloads for appendix. :robot_face:

alex: CTA mapping to routing: 1) 14-day Dedicated trial -> AE; 2) Run-your-workload against our harness (first 5k tokens free) -> SWE-led demo; 3) Register for webinar -> marketing nurture. Option 2 gated with NDA if PII.

sam: Benchmark appendix should include: harness repo link, seed prompts, measurement script, and environment (GPU type, batch settings, quantization). We'll avoid absolute "faster" claims; use measured context.

jen: Messaging vs cloud platforms: emphasize operational knobs (batching, cache, quantization) and predictable economics. Against infra vendors: emphasize unified runtime + out-of-the-box rollbacks & fallbacks.

aaron: We should prepare three one-paragraph customer vignettes: startup (PLG), mid-market (payment SaaS with compliance), and platform team (internal services). Each shows migration path hosted->dedicated->private.

pat_k: Action items: alex + sam - landing CTAs + benchmark outline; jen - 3 soundbites + customer vignette drafts; aaron + pat_k - inbound routing matrix; nick_r - webinar slide skeleton (5 slides). Maya will run the session.

maya: Thanks team. Drop any pre-reads in #marketing-assets before 9:30. See you at 10. :thumbsup:
